items.method_review: Corrected accrual-versus-cash CFADS basis is explicit, then only qualified annual cash enters sculpting and contract-rate remaining-loan-horizon cover.

findings.detail: Pre-WC accrual proxies exclude noncash expenses; already-cash sources omit previously embedded working-capital adjustment.
Terminal input is signed replacement-minus-keep difference, not replacement sale alone.
Sold-unit contribution and full-cohort net cash are separately calculated and labeled.
Chargeable passages precede collection loss; already-paid traffic is not discounted twice.
Annual-service/12 assumption is explicitly uniform monthly service only.

limitations: No claim of source transaction truth or legal eligibility: signed contracts and dated records remain required.
Native author has separately tested workbook recalculation/export/reimport; this independent report additionally verifies exact hashes and actual rendered layout.
Nearest existing method evidence is pinned separately; broad treasury/credit/planning methods do not replace these focused actual-source financial schedules.

nearest_existing_methods.source_evidence: Full main method: broad cash ladder, VaR/forwards, sweep and investment policy report. New schedules are explicit restrictions, signed settlement and rate/fee reconciliations; no copy of broad recommendations or VaR claim.

Full main method: connector/CSV30/60/90 net windows, historical lag and percentage-variance bands, source-dependent XLSX. New intraday ordered buckets and frozen signed-flow drift avoid generic forecast duplication and unsupported default confidence bands.

Full-method prior audit reused at exact hash: decimal line/subtotal/tax arithmetic and invoice completeness. New bank/availability schedules add actual contract fee bases, credits/caps and period records; no tax inference.

Full-method prior audit reused at exact hash: budget/actual bridge, materiality and MAPE. New treasury backtest explicitly reconciles frozen signed net flows to cumulative cash drift, uses currency MAE with zero/negative flows, and claims no statistical accuracy score.

Full method read: broad5Cs, ratios, capacity, stress, collateral and covenant design. New borrowing-base tiers, actual capacity bridge, cash service tests and principal schedule are source-specific numeric contracts, with no approve/decline benchmark copied.

Full method read: IAS2/ASC330 inventory formula, absorption and NRV/provisions. New collateral certificate uses legal eligible population, appraisal advance caps and lender reserves, not statutory inventory valuation.

Full method read: consumer avalanche/snowball monthly minimum/extra payment simulation. New revolver fees and construction interest use contractual facility bases and draw timing, not consumer payoff strategies.

Full method read: multi-year normalized earnings, all fixed claims, historical bars and refinancing cover. New cash fixed-charge bridge and loan-life contract PV have different numerator, period and purpose, with no inherited heuristic score.

Full method read: business dependence by client/platform/region/work/keyperson, supplier/credit dependence and proposed limits. New creditor exposure uses connected funded and policy-weighted undrawn facilities, not revenue shares or client exit plans.

Full method read: haircuts, term extensions, debt/equity swaps and restructuring versus liquidation. New maturity funding ladder and operating payment priority use already contracted terms, not restructuring negotiation or recovery priorities.
Full method read: earnings/depreciation/working capital/capex and four25point tests. New CFADS is explicitly contract-qualified receipt/payment cash with no synthetic100score or equity valuation.

Full method read: earned value, CPI/SPI, EAC and TCPI. New committed funding/draw/interest/completion schedules distinguish actual financing capacity from cost performance and avoid inferring completion date from financial ratio.

Full method read: ad efficiency curves, returning cohorts, events and target-gap sizing. Toll schedule uses sourced chargeable passages before collection loss and realized collections, not ecommerce curves or claimed forecast accuracy.

Full method read: material/labor price/efficiency and overhead spending/volume variances. Replaced initially proposed absorption duplicate with shared-service activity allocation. Yield model is physical mass plus evidenced scrap cash, not a renamed standard variance.

Full method read: direct versus partner fullyloaded cost-to-serve, cash/LTV/marginal ROI and mix optimizer. New shared-service activity pool explicitly reconciles unused capacity, and service hours/fees avoids channel ROI verdicts or optimization.

Full method read: design/effective/OEE, process bottleneck, DBR, aggregate LP, CRP, capacity investment and decision trees. Product mix checker is explicitly a supplied proposal with financial contribution and one bottleneck identity, not an optimizer or full capacity/production feasibility model.

Full method reused/current read: workload, skills, time/budget and utilization targets. New service actual hours and realized fees reconcile direct contribution with explicit cost scope; no inherited utilization benchmark or personnel performance rating.

Full main source read in earlier independent audit, same hash rechecked: property room pricing/LOS/channel/overbooking/forecast scaffold. New actual channel contribution avoids source code bugs, optimizer claims, hardcoded values and overbooking advice.

Full method read: factory unit-price parts/labor/overhead/margin sheet, sourcing, volume breaks and return-risk ideas. New restaurant schedule adds measured edible mass, portions, served demand and complete batch cash rather than factory negotiation.

Full method read: per-order discount, requiredROAS/CPA, offer types and heuristic100score. New old-stock cohort reconciles sold/full/markdown/closing units and preserves historical purchase cost without forecasting conversion or assigning a score.

Avoids source TCO double-counting purchase plus depreciation and its default safety/maintenance thresholds.
